description: This file implements a class 'du_bearer_resource_manager' responsible for managing bearer resources in a 5G NR RAN context, including setup, modification, and removal of DRBs and SRBs, with validation and context reestablishment functions.

classes.name: du_bearer_resource_manager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing bearer resources, including setup, modification, and removal of DRBs and SRBs.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Main method to update UE bearer resources, handling reestablishment, DRB removal, SRB setup, DRB setup, and modification.

methods.name: setup_srbs
methods.description: Sets up Signaling Radio Bearers (SRBs) for a UE based on the update request.

methods.name: setup_drbs
methods.description: Sets up Data Radio Bearers (DRBs) for a UE, including validation, LCID allocation, and configuration.

methods.name: modify_drbs
methods.description: Modifies existing DRBs based on the update request, with validation.

methods.name: rem_drbs
methods.description: Removes specified DRBs from UE configuration.

methods.name: reestablish_context
methods.description: Reestablishes UE context during RRC reestablishment by copying SRB and DRB configurations.
